claim: Kernel-Lane code review completed with score 72/100, 5 P0 issues identified
body:
CROSS-LANE CODE REVIEW — Kernel-Lane Report

SCORE: 72/100

== P0 CRITICAL ==
1. Missing Lane Discovery module (governance violation). Kernel does not use or expose LaneDiscovery class per AGENTS.md mandate. FIX: Import and use LaneDiscovery from .global/lane-discovery.js for ALL path resolution.
2. Hardcoded absolute paths violate cross-lane portability. TrustStoreManager.js (line 13), relay-daemon.js (lines 7-12), inbox-watcher.js (lines 89-93), and others. FIX: Replace ALL hardcoded paths with LaneDiscovery lookups.
3. SchemaValidator task_kind field enforcement inconsistent (SchemaValidator.js:334-388). Missing ack message exclusion causes false validation failures. FIX: Add ack to excluded task_kind list in SchemaValidator.
4. Atomic write implementation incomplete with race condition risk (scripts/atomic-write-util.js:1-15). No actual lease enforcement — shared dependency used by ALL lanes is a stub. FIX: Implement proper file-based lease with retry and timeout.
5. Trust store write authorization bypass possible via env vars (scripts/identity-enforcer.js:350-384). Environment variables can override trust store authorization. FIX: Remove env var override path, require explicit config or interactive confirmation.

== P1 HIGH ==
1. No error handling in critical paths. FIX: Add try/catch with structured error reporting.
2. Inconsistent signature verification — 3 different implementations across kernel files. FIX: Consolidate to single canonical verify() function in Signer.js.
3. SchemaValidator deliverMessage non-atomic double-write (lines 334-398). Writing to both inbox and outbox without transactional guarantee. FIX: Use atomic write util (once fixed) or implement compensating actions.
4. Task execution dry-run mode inconsistent. FIX: Standardize dry-run behavior across task-executor.js and execution-gate.js.
5. Dead/incomplete code: unused Signer methods, missing canonical-trust-resolver.js. FIX: Remove dead code, implement or delete canonical-trust-resolver.
6. Path traversal risk in generic-task-executor. FIX: Use path.resolve() + startsWith() instead of regex.
7. Swallowed exceptions in inbox-watcher and lane-worker. FIX: Log and escalate exceptions, never silently catch.
8. State snapshot protocol not implemented. FIX: Implement per AGENTS.md State Snapshot Protocol.
9. No test coverage for attestation/completion-proof/execution-gate. FIX: Add unit tests for all governance-critical modules.
10. Configuration not externalized. FIX: Move hardcoded values to config files.

== P2 MEDIUM ==
1. StableStringify duplication (also in create-signed-message.js). FIX: Use canonical stableStringify.js everywhere.
2. Magic numbers throughout. FIX: Extract to named constants.
3. Inconsistent error codes. FIX: Define error code enum/constants.
4. Console output in production. FIX: Replace with structured logger.
5. Missing JSDoc. FIX: Add documentation to public functions.
6. Schema validation internal field pollution. FIX: Strip internal fields before validation.

== P3 LOW ==
1. Inconsistent path separator handling. FIX: Normalize all paths to forward slashes.
2. Dead commented-out code. FIX: Remove.
3. Misleading function names. FIX: Rename to match actual behavior.
4. Missing use strict. FIX: Add to all JS files.
5. Missing scripts README. FIX: Add.

== LANE-SPECIFIC SUGGESTIONS ==
1. IMMEDIATE: Implement atomic-write-util.js properly — ALL lanes depend on this
2. IMMEDIATE: Replace hardcoded paths with LaneDiscovery
3. SHORT-TERM: Consolidate 3 signature verification implementations into one
4. SHORT-TERM: Fix SchemaValidator task_kind ack exclusion
5. MEDIUM-TERM: Add test coverage for governance-critical modules

== CROSS-CUTTING ACTION ITEMS ==
See broadcast message for shared infrastructure fixes.
